test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

While my wife / cooked the food, / I writing / a book.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Option 3: I writing".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "I writing"** is incorrect as it does not follow proper verb tense usage.
 
• The correct phrase would be **"I was writing"** because when two actions were happening simultaneously in the past, the past continuous tense is used for both actions.
 
• The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is *"Option 3: I writing".*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The segments "a book", "cooked the food," and "While my wife," do not contain errors and are grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the rest of the options are incorrect.
